sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194489
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 31827 of 2024

Applicant :- Rinku
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Brajesh Kumar Singh,Shiva Kant Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed by the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Shiva Kant Dubey and Sri Brajesh Kumar Singh, learned counsels for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra, learned brief holder for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
181 of 2024, under Sections 323, 376-D, 452, 506 IPC, Police Station- Makkhanpur, District- Firozabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsels for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with co-accused Krishna and after considering entire facts of the case, co-accused Krishna has been released on bail vide order dated 07.11.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 39389 of 2024 and on facts, case of applicant is at par with him.
Rinku vs State Of U.P. on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54728849/
1 5.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: They further submitted that apart from the present case, however, applicant is having criminal history of one another case but that case is of Section 304-A IPC and his criminal history has been explained in the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant bail application.
6. They further submitted that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 26.07.2024.
7. Per contra, learned AGA however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
9. However, there is allegation of rape against the applicant and co-accused Krishna but co-accused Krishna has already been released on bail by this Court and case of applicant is at par with him.

10. Further, apart from the present case, however, applicant is having criminal history of one another case but that case is of Section 304-A IPC and his criminal history has been explained in the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant bail application and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 26.07.2024.
11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Rinku be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
